articles.title: The inflation scenario that could send bitcoin tumbling below $60,000
Chainalysis, South Korean police link up to fight crypto crime
articles.snippet: South Korea's national police has been battling crypto-enabled crimes from DPRK-state level threats to scams targeting retail investors.

articles.title: Solana Institute CEO says CLARITY Act must shield open-source developers
articles.snippet: Kristin Smith urged the Senate to preserve developer protections in the CLARITY Act, arguing open-source builders should not be regulated as financial intermediaries.

articles.title: Mastercard Enables AI Agent Payments With Help From Crypto Giants Like Coinbase, Ripple
articles.snippet: Mastercard's Agent Pay for Machines is designed to let AI buy services and settle transactions using cards, bank accounts, and stablecoins.

articles.title: Solana Sponsors the World Series of Poker, Enabling Crypto Entry Fees and Payouts
articles.snippet: Players can now enter World Series of Poker tournaments with SOL or stablecoins, with Solana branding to be prominent at events.
